en: Chromolithographed multi‑view postcard with floral decoration. Main view is a panoramic cityscape labeled "Kronstadt v. Schlossberg." Two inset scenes show "Schutzhütte am Schuler" and "Schützenhaus." The front has bilingual greetings in German and Hungarian. The reverse reads "Levelező‑lap." with address lines and bears a purple circular stamp of the Brukenthal Museum in Hermannstadt.
